title: Calculate element by element
summary: Adding two arrays of the same shape adds matching positions. This is element-wise addition.
introduction: Adding two arrays of the same shape adds matching positions. This is element-wise addition. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Adding two arrays of the same shape adds matching positions. This is element-wise addition.

blocks.code:
import numpy as np

a = np.array([1, 2, 3])
b = np.array([10, 20, 30])
print((a + b).tolist())
blocks.title: Calculate element by element

blocks.text: The output is [11, 22, 33]. Each position adds one value from a and the matching value from b.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Subtract b from a and predict each position.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Array addition is not the same as joining two Python lists.
